prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman cosplayer, mid 20s, with a cat-girl heroine look brought to life, with a short fluffy honey-blonde bob with a straight fringe and soft fluffy cat ears nestled in her hair, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round eyes with an enormous visible iris in bright leaf green contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, long lashes and a soft peach shimmer on the lids, under thin, high, simple brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up about half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, with the iris filling most of the eye opening, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are small and soft, in a pink gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, with the corners lifted in a cheerful cat-like smile. A deeper pink blush spreads in soft round patches over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded dot with a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils almost invisible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a narrow, delicately pointed anime face shape. A curious, cheerful, wide-eyed gaze. Her skin is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, and a light natural sheen only on the nose and forehead, the rest of the face in a soft natural matte finish — a photograph of a living woman's face with real flesh and warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face. Jewelry: on each ear, three separate heavy ear weights of real blackened cast iron hanging from a polished silver ring through the lobe, each on its own silver chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim, a cube-shaped block, a miniature anvil; on the right ear a square-sided cowbell, a ship's anchor, a barrel-shaped weight. Every weight is a dense, solid, rough, matte, hammered lump of black cast iron about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears a real chunky sterling silver cable-chain necklace resting on her collarbones.

Background: a softly blurred cozy cafe window with warm afternoon light.

Lighting: bright, soft, even light across her face with only gentle shading, and a thin rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
